name: Tramremise Lekstraat

surveyed.source: Vertex average of the BAG 0363100012106929 ring (PDOK BAG, CC0) in native east/south metres (scripts/landmarks/tramremise-lekstraat-footprints.json, modern-prepare.mjs). Walls and roofs are the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (AHN4, CC BY 4.0; ground 0.125 m NAP): eight east-west roof lanterns, the two-level perimeter band, the office with its tower and the Amsteldijk house block. Glazed north and solar south lantern slopes from the PDOK orthophoto; facade detail from rectified Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas of Kromme-Mijdrechtstraat, Waverstraat and the Amsteldijk yard (scripts/landmarks/tramremise-lekstraat-inventory.json).

attribution.title: Tramremise Lekstraat (1927-1930, Dienst der Publieke Werken)
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry: the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) on the BAG footprint (CC0) with the roof lanterns coloured as glazing and solar panels from the PDOK orthophoto (CC BY 4.0); the stone plinth, concrete copings and parapets, white steel hall windows, clerestory row, risalits and stepped stone consoles of the Kromme-Mijdrechtstraat front; the office and tower windows with green drip boards, the arched tower door with its 1927 plaque; the brick oriel, door and louvres of the Amsteldijk house block; the curved west tram front and the east tram front with their piers, canopies and folding tram doors; read for proportion only from the Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.

partyWallEvidence: NO PHOTO EVIDENCE, not a true party wall. The long south elevation (190 deg, 88.5 x 10.1 m and 63 x 9.1 m) faces the private back gardens of the Lekstraat housing blocks and is hidden from every public panorama (w02-190: recording_2024-09-05_05-59-45_03962 and TMX7316010203-000774_pano_0000_004250 show only the housing fronts); the PDOK orthophoto shows only its coping. No windows, doors or recesses are modelled or claimed there. The integrator may prefer to hold the model until a photo of that wall exists.
